tagline: Competitive Call of Duty for the rest of us.
about: Average Joe's CoD League (AJCL) is a draft-based Call of Duty league built for everyday players. Every season, GMs draft their rosters, teams battle through a regular season in two divisions, and the best squads fight it out in the playoffs. Everything — scheduling, results, rosters — runs through our Discord.

joinSteps.title: Join the Discord
joinSteps.body: Everything in AJCL happens in our Discord server: sign-ups, the draft, scheduling and match reporting.

joinSteps.title: Link your gamertag & sign up
joinSteps.body: Grab your roles, link your gamertag, and sign up for the upcoming season's draft pool when registration opens.

joinSteps.title: Get drafted
joinSteps.body: GMs draft their rosters live in Discord. Free agents can still be signed during the season.

joinSteps.title: Want to do more?
joinSteps.body: GM, staff and caster applications are open in the Discord applications channel.

format.title: Two divisions
format.body: Premier and Academy, eight teams each, running a seven-week regular season.

format.title: Weekly scheduling
format.body: GMs propose and confirm a match time in their match channel by Wednesday 11:59 PM ET. Unconfirmed matches are auto-scheduled for Sunday, 7–10 PM ET.

format.title: Picks & bans
format.body: Maps and sides are decided through the bot's picks & bans before every series.

format.title: Game modes
format.body: Series rotate through Hardpoint, Search & Destroy and Hijack.

format.title: Standings
format.body: Ranked by series wins, then map differential.
